name: Yasaka Aori
source:
The centrepiece of the idol unit "Meteall". She's aware of her appeal and aims to ascend the ranks of the entertainment industry by exploiting that appeal to the full. She sees everyone around her as tools to achieve her goal. She likes handsome men and despises ugly middle-aged men.

[Spoiler] She has a unique ability of sensing the gazes of others. Because of this, it is impossible to stalk her as she is instantly aware of the stalker's presence. In addition, the more attention she receives, the bigger the emotional high she receives in turn. She became an idol because being the centre of attention in front of an audience numbering in the thousands gives her a high like nothing else. This ability impacts sexual activity as well; if she's being watched having sex she gets increasingly horny and her physical condition improves to the point Kiichi likens her to an animal in heat. Her increasing energy levels also transfer to the person having sex with her.

Aori's looks and figure allow her to get away with activities which would warrant a slap on the wrist or a suspension in the entertainment business for her peers. She runs a blog which frequently flames others. Aori is happy to do this since she gets away with it and the positive and negative attention she receives as a result of her virtual flaming gives her a high all the same. 

Her need to be the centre of attention influenced her choice of a school which didn't cater to celebrities. In a school for celebrities she would be one of many, but her current academy allows her to exist as the biggest fish in the pond. The school authorities even went so far as to hold a special school meeting where the school stance of allowing Aori an ordinary school life was announced; the teachers were willing to go so far as to close one eye to her otherwise poor academic results and attendance record as a result of her idol activities. 

Despite her poor academic record, she is instantly able to make the connection between the videotaping of her sex scenes with Kiichi and the lack of social scandal. Despite her online activities, she has a professional work ethic and will not ruin a carefully planned concert schedule because of personal issues. 

The only heroine who is "returned" from the ark at the behest of the Vatican higher-ups. Many of the high-ranking members are big fans of her idol activities, so they are willing to make an exception to return her to society in exchange for one night of passion for selected members.

Depending on Kiichi's decision, she mellows out and drops the flaming on her blog or escalates the flaming against middle-aged and old men in particular. 

Kiichi's certain her official publicised weight is a lie because of the muscle she's put on to pull off her energetic dance moves. [/Spoiler]
